seo.title: Full Stack Web Designer
seo.description: Corentin Renard - Full Stack Web Designer. UI/UX design, custom web development, and ongoing maintenance for landing pages, showcase websites, and e-commerce.

name: Corentin Renard
avatarJoke: Yes, my name means Fox. No, I didn't pick a fox as my profile picture.

hero.intro: I design and build sharp web experiences for founders, local brands and teams that need a site with taste, performance and real maintainability.

design.title: Design
design.description: UI/UX design on Figma, wireframes and prototypes

integration.title: Integration
integration.description: Real integration with feedback loops until you're satisfied

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Ongoing support and updates to keep your site running smoothly

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Indicative pricing only, quote on request

availability.question: Are you available for new projects?
availability.answer: Yes, I am available for new freelance projects, especially well-scoped web missions where design, development and maintenance all matter.

location.question: Where are you based?
location.answer: I am based in France and I work remotely with both French-speaking and English-speaking clients.

stack.question: Which technologies do you use?
stack.answer: I design interfaces in Figma, then build them with Nuxt, Vue, Tailwind CSS and whatever fits the website or CMS requirement.

pricing.question: How much does a website cost?
pricing.answer: A landing page starts from €900, a showcase website from €2,500, an e-commerce website from €4,500, and I quote custom projects after scoping.

works.title: Featured Works
works.subtitle: A flexible space for client missions, case studies and personal projects.
